summary: Send optional field replacements for changed collection rows without repeating unchanged values.

replay.detail: No claim projection, replay or admission changes.

schema.detail: No database schema or migration changes. The client JSON schema adds optional field delta commands and patches.

rules.detail: No checkpoint or fleet rules changes.

compatibility.detail: Clients may opt in with field_deltas=true on the existing collections v0 socket. Initial and reconnect snapshots remain complete, new rows and kind changes use full upserts, and changed existing rows may use patches. Null is a value; removed_fields deletes fields. Missing or malformed patch bases require an authoritative resubscription. Requests without the option keep full upserts; older daemons ignore the option and keep full upserts. Generated Rust and TypeScript helpers support patches, and the shared Rust feed retries invalid bases. Subscription bounds remain sixteen current/eight older.

downtime.detail: Only the normal daemon replacement restart; clients reconnect for complete snapshots.

manual.detail: No installation steps. Consumers opt in only after adopting the field patch fold.

recovery.detail: No persisted state changes. Clients can omit the option, or replace the daemon with the prior build, to retain full upserts.
